description.value: Jeremy Koreski Gallery is a photography gallery in the heart of Tofino showcasing the work of local outdoor photographer Jeremy Koreski, who grew up in this coastal town and built his career documenting surfing, wildlife, and the wild landscapes of the BC coast. Koreski's distinctive aerial images — captured by hanging out of helicopters over Clayoquot Sound — have been published internationally by outlets including The New York Times and Patagonia. A visit offers a compelling window into the natural world that cyclists riding the West Coast are passing through, with hand-signed prints also available online.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms the gallery at 440 Campbell Street, Tofino, BC next to Storm Surf Shop, matching the OSM address. The website is active (© 2026, live Shopify store) and confirms the business is open to the public, but makes no mention of bike parking, washrooms, water, or any cycling-specific amenities. The OSM name 'Jeremy Koreski' differs from the full business name 'Jeremy Koreski Gallery' as consistently used throughout the website; the phone number in OSM does not appear on the website (contact page directs to email only), so phone confirmation is null.
concerns: OSM name is 'Jeremy Koreski' but the business consistently uses 'Jeremy Koreski Gallery' on its website — the OSM record may benefit from a name update.

Phone number (+1 250 725 0323) appears in OSM but is not listed anywhere on the website; the contact page directs visitors to email only (prints@jeremykoreski.com). Phone cannot be confirmed from website evidence.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A legitimate, active photography gallery in central Tofino celebrating BC's coastal and wilderness landscapes — a culturally relevant and accessible stop for touring cyclists exploring the West Coast.

wow_evidence: Gallery of internationally published Tofino outdoor photographer — a real cut above an ordinary gallery.
